title: WARDEN Mobile
shortDescription: Private browser with ad blocking for admins: no account, no telemetry.
fullDescription:
WARDEN Mobile is a privacy-first browser for security and network administrators, and the mobile companion to WARDEN for Windows.

It is a browser, not a launcher: pages render in the app's own web view with WARDEN's address bar, back, forward, reload and progress line, and requests to known ad and tracker hosts are refused before they leave the app. The empty slot a blocked ad leaves behind is removed so the page closes up.

WHAT IT DOES
• Real browser surface: the page and its chrome belong to the app, not to a browser app you did not choose.
• Ad and tracker blocking: ad and tracker hosts are blocked at the request level, and a cosmetic pass removes the containers a blocked ad leaves behind.
• Session wiped: cookies, web storage and cache are cleared when the browser closes. No history, no profile, no account — the app keeps only its own preferences.
• No third-party cookies: a page keeps its own session cookie so a login still works; nothing follows the reader between sites.
• No telemetry: no analytics SDK, no crash reporter, no tracking identifiers, no ad SDKs.
• No sensor access: the app never requests camera or microphone.

OPERATOR SURFACES
• Scry reads the page in front of you: its stack, the third parties it called, the trackers that got through, its forms and endpoints. The report stays on the screen, not on the device.
• Services opens Slack, Teams, WhatsApp and the rest in the same WARDEN browser, with a sign-in that survives between opens. Mail does the same for your mail provider's web client.

NOT IN THIS BUILD
DNS over HTTPS, per-tab isolation, and the desktop build's shell and IMAP mail client are planned in the public repository and are not here yet. The app says so on its own screen rather than implying otherwise.

WHO IT IS FOR
Security administrators and network administrators who want a browser that refuses by default and explains its refusals. No account required, no configuration to start.

PRIVACY POLICY
https://innotelinc.github.io/warden/privacy.html

contentRating.questionnaire: No user-generated content, no ads, no purchases, no location, no camera or microphone. Rate: Everyone.

dataSafety.deletionRequest: No data is collected, so there is nothing to delete; uninstalling removes the app's local preferences.
dataSafety.notes: The app has no analytics or crash SDK. Pages opened in the platform browser surface are governed by that browser's own policy and by the sites themselves.

notes: Upload the signed .aab produced by .github/workflows/mobile-android.yml. First release also needs the Play Console data-safety form filled from dataSafety above and the content-rating questionnaire answered as described.
